section2_live_deploy.method: fetch tool per URL (sandbox curl has no egress to github.io). Title comparison against docs/ built locally and gate-verified reproducible. The disclosure strip is enforced per page by tools/checks.py on the build (and the gate proves docs/ == root mirror == committed root, which legacy Pages serves); the fetch tool's markdown conversion omits role=note chrome, so live disclosure presence is established by build byte-identity + per-page title match rather than by markdown text.
